stumbles.quote: Choose your options on the first screen, holding the phone upright
stumbles.why: Step 1 locked portrait and the game hasn't asked for landscape yet, so it's fine, but "upright" is ambiguous (portrait vs. vertical); minor. More importantly, the instruction to hold it a certain way for option selection is unexplained.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone the way you want to drive it.
stumbles.why: Unclear what orientation or angle is meant, e.g. flat or tilted up. It's also unclear whether neutral can be changed after the lights go out.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: In landscape the "top" of the phone is ambiguous, because the phone's top edge changes with rotation. It's unclear which edge is meant.

point: Lock portrait, open the game, pick track, laps and difficulty, tap Start engine, rotate to landscape and hold the phone in your driving position, which becomes neutral when the lights go out, then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
